risks.risk: PS4 model/storage (Fat vs Slim vs Pro, and HDD size) is not readable from the photos, which strongly affects value.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the console label/serial sticker showing model (CUH-xxxx) and storage/HDD info, plus a photo of the back ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case match among the PS4 listings (lowest PS4 tier comparable), assuming it’s not a Pro and storage may be smaller.

risks.risk: Games and controller are not shown; could be missing items or fewer games than claimed.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of the controller(s) and all game discs/cases (or a screenshot showing the installed games list on the PS4).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console-only / minimal bundle (worst case: treat as not including the full claimed games and only 1 pad).

risks.risk: Hacked/modified status is unknown from photos; some buyers discount heavily if it’s hacked or if accounts/licenses are involved.
risks.proof: Ask for a boot-up video showing the home screen and system settings (and whether it’s on a custom firmware), or a photo of System Information.
risks.if_unproven: Price as hacked/uncertain condition (worst case discount), since it’s common in this market and cannot be confirmed either way.

risks.risk: Working condition (disc drive, HDMI, Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth, ports) cannot be verified from photos.
risks.proof: Ask for a short test video: console boot + play a game + show controller pairing + HDMI/USB ports working.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed (worst case: assume it may have issues) until tested.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the PS4 model label (CUH-xxxx) and any storage/HDD info (photo of the sticker).
Photo(s) showing the included controller(s) and all accessories (power cable, HDMI, etc.).
Photo(s) showing the 10 games (discs/cases) OR a screenshot/video of the installed games list on the PS4 home screen.
Short boot + gameplay test video (controller connected, game launches, audio/video output).
response.reason: The photos only confirm a Sony PS4 console exists; the PS4 model/storage and the claimed bundle (10 games + 1 controller) are not verifiable from the images, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
